title: Realising the Vision of a 45-Minute City under the Land Transport Master Plan 2040 in the West of Singapore
what_it_is: Realising the Vision of a 45-Minute City under the Land Transport Master Plan 2040 in the West of Singapore

sections.label: 45-minute city West Singapore
sections.summary: Realising the vision of a 45-minute city in the West of Singapore under the Land Transport Master Plan 2040, coinciding with the PSLE and population exceeding six million.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Realising the vision of a 45-minute city in the West of Singapore under the Land Transport Master Plan 2040.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: This six-day breakdown also happened to coincide with the Primary School Leaving Examination (PSLE) and the announcement that Singapore's population exceeded six million for the first time.

sections.label: LTA 45-minute city goal
sections.summary: In 2019, LTA set a goal in the Land Transport Master Plan 2040 for Singaporeans to spend no more than 45 minutes on nine out of 10 peak-period journeys.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: In 2019, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) has set an ambitious goal in the Land Transport Master Plan 2040 to make Singapore a 45-minute city where Singaporeans should spend no more than 45 minutes to complete nine out of 10 peak-period journeys.

sections.label: JRL extension proposals connectivity
sections.summary: Then-Minister S Iswaran said in 2022 authorities would study this, and two proposals to extend the JRL will increase rail connectivity from the West.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Then-Minister S Iswaran also said, in 2022, that the authorities would study this as, "We need to create meaningful connections in our MRT stations for convenience and resilience." These two proposals to extend the JRL will greatly increase rail connectivity from the West to the Downtown Core and the rest of Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: We are glad that, this morning, Minister Chee Hong Tat has mentioned that the Ministry of Transport will look into these proposals.

sections.label: Skip-stop bus services
sections.summary: Two types of skip-stop bus services should be introduced.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Two types of skip-stop bus services should be introduced.

sections.label: PSP JRL extension proposals
sections.summary: PSP believes the Government should implement two proposals under study regarding the JRL, the first being to extend it from Pandan Reservoir station to Haw Par Villa station.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: PSP believes that to achieve this vision for western residents, the Government should implement two proposals currently under study regarding the JRL.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The first is to extend the JRL from Pandan Reservoir station to Haw Par Villa station on the Circle Line.

sections.label: West households near train stations
sections.summary: With planned rail network expansions, eight in 10 households in the West are on track to be within a 10-minute walk of a train station by the 2030s.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: With planned expansions to the rail network, we are on track to having eight in 10 households in the West within a 10-minute walk of a train station by the 2030s, which is aligned with our target for the entire island.

sections.label: Jurong Region Line opening
sections.summary: The JRL will open in stages between 2027 and 2029 and will be a game-changer for the West.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: The JRL will be a game-changer for the West when it opens in stages between 2027 and 2029.

sections.label: Cross Island Line journey times
sections.summary: With the CRL, journeys will be reduced to 45 minutes to Pasir Ris and 30 minutes to Ang Mo Kio.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: With the CRL, these journeys will be reduced to 45 minutes to Pasir Ris and 30 minutes to Ang Mo Kio.

sections.label: Bus connectivity for new estates
sections.summary: Improving bus connectivity meets immediate travel demand while rail expansion takes time, including new trunk and feeder services for new estates like Tengah.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: This is especially important as new housing developments are being completed at a faster pace, which means that there are new needs that have to be met.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: We recognise that as the planned expansion of our rail network will take some time to complete, improving bus connectivity will help meet travel demand in the immediate term.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: That is why we have taken further steps through the recently announced Bus Connectivity Enhancement Programme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Mr Leong's suggestion for buses is no different from this.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: We will also speed up the pace of introducing new trunk and feeder bus services and improving bus frequencies to improve connectivity for the early batches of residents who move into new estates like Tengah.

sentences.text: Pursuant to Standing Order 2(3)(a), I wish to inform hon Members that the Sitting tomorrow will commence at 11.00 am.
